profile.headline: Retired - Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Technical Lead with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications and broadcast media industries.  Strong engineering professional skilled in Firmware, Device Drivers, Radio Frequency (RF), and Cloud Based Software Development.

positions.title: Retirement
positions.description: Less work-work.  More fun-work.  I still plan to enjoy the memories of good times and all the great folks I met along the way.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend Transaction processing design and development.  Work included efficiency enhancements, transaction security upgrades, and muti-site 24/7 support.

positions.title: Sr. Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Cloud based IP-TV solutions software developer focused on control plane code for restart, catchup, and personal recordings.  Container based micro-service cloud environments have provided experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS along with node.js and GoLang to manage databases including Couchbase and MongoDB.  Actively participate in software architecture, coding, continuous integration(CI) test suite maintenance using pytest, deployment verification, updating release notes, interfacing with devOps, troubleshooting, and mentoring junior engineers.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description: Embedded Linux drivers for various components of Broadcom SOC based cable set-top boxes including: NVM drivers( C, C++), shell scripts, vendor integration, and Cable Card firmware integration.  Cloud based development and deployment for IP TV micro-services utilizing JavaScript, OpenStack, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and AWS.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Engineer
positions.description: Real time embedded software design and development using C and C++ with primary focus on DMA and transport drivers for delivery of QAM, inband QPSK, and DOCIS data to all parts of the cable settop box subsystems running PowerTV OS.

positions.title: SW Engineering Mgr
positions.description: Managed a small  team of engineers to develop custom test automation tools and scripts used to verify new features such as SMS (texting) on cell phones.  Work also included trade shows, white paper presentations regarding cutting edge wireless test solutions.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded C software development for Qualcom based SOC CDMA cell phones.  Work included CDMA signal processing algorithm improvements, field testing, data collection.  Acquired 2 patents.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Leader
positions.description: Industry: 2-way public safety mobile radio and cellular phone products.  Roles: RF engineer, firmware engineer, R&D team lead
